description: Figure 2 (“Ever-scalingness”) is a four-slice pie chart illustrating four benchmark desiderata arranged as quadrants around the center, with a total of 4 categories. The top-left slice is labeled “Complexity,” colored yellow/orange, and is associated with the callout “Uncrushable.” The top-right slice is labeled “Instance,” colored light blue, and is associated with the callout “Unhackable.” The bottom-right slice is labeled “Coverage,” colored light green, and is associated with the callout “General.” The bottom-left slice is labeled “Oversight,” colored red, and is associated with the callout “Auto-verifiable.” There are no numeric percentage labels shown inside the slices, and the slices appear equal in size; the figure uses external rounded callout boxes for the four descriptors and includes small icons near the center, with no exploded or offset segments and no separate legend.
